item.title: Flotsam launches December 5
item.description: Floating city builder Flotsam will leave Early Access and launch for PC via Steam and GOG on December 5, Stray Fawn Publishing and developer Pajama Llama Games announced.

item.title: Into the Fire launches in Early Access in 2026
item.description: Cataclysm extraction survival game Into the Fire will launch in Early Access for PC via Steam and GOG in 2026, developer Starward Industries announced. A playtest is coming “soon.”
